svg.title: Architectural drawing
svg.desc: Elevation of a garden grotto: a mound of rough rockwork with an arched cave mouth hung with drips, a ring of scallop shells round the opening and a pool in front, with a round close-up of the shells and rough blocks beside the opening. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
svg.text: SOURCE: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric
construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
